mapper.select: SELECT T.create_user as launchUser, T.TRADE_ID AS portfolioId, T.NEXT_USER AS nextUser, T.CRT_DATE AS createTaskTime, sd.institution_code instCode ,case when T.BUSINESS_TYPE = 'PTL01' then nvl(pp.portfolio_name,replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(sdpm.business_data,'"portfolioName":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"portfolioName":"',''),'"','') ) else nvl(fp.FINPROD_ABBR,replace(replace(to_char(REGEXP_SUBSTR(sdpm.business_data,'"finprodAbbr":"[^"]+"',1,1)),'"finprodAbbr":"',''),'"','') ) end as portfolioName FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T left join ( select pm.workflow_id workflow_id,pm.business_data business_data from sys_data_process_mark pm inner join ( select workflow_id, max(his_no) HIS_NO from sys_data_process_mark group by workflow_id ) tempHis on pm.HIS_NO = tempHis.HIS_NO and pm.WORKFLOW_ID = tempHis.WORKFLOW_ID ) sdpm on sdpm.workflow_id = t.seq_no LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su on T.CRT_USER =su.user_name LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT sd ON SU.DEPT_CODE = sd.Dept_Code left join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_market_id = t.TRADE_ID and fp.finprod_type = 'F16' left join ptl_portfolio pp on pp.portfolio_id = t.TRADE_ID WHERE T.PROCESS_STATE not in ('END','NEW') AND T.BUSINESS_TYPE in ( 'PTL01','FINPROD04') and T.crt_date <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}
